title: Assignment 1 — Survey of a research area
instructions:
Choose one research area from the list shared in class and write a structured survey of it.

Work in your group. Every member must write part of the text — your instructor can see who wrote each paragraph. Put figures, spreadsheets and code in your own Google Drive or GitHub and add the links under Supplementary files.

Cite every source in IEEE style. Similarity above 15% (excluding references) is reported.

questions.question: Introduction and scope: what is the area, why does it matter, and what does this survey cover (and not cover)?
questions.guidance: About 300–500 words. End with the research questions your survey answers.
questions.starter:
## Background
## Why it matters
## Scope of this survey
## Research questions
questions.modelAnswer: Clear definition of the area (1), motivation with evidence (1), explicit scope incl. exclusions (1), 2–4 answerable research questions (2).

questions.question: Literature review: summarise and compare at least eight peer-reviewed papers published in the last five years.
questions.guidance: Use a comparison table (method, dataset, metric, key result, limitation). Group papers by approach, not one paragraph per paper.
questions.starter:
## Search method
## Approach 1
## Approach 2
## Comparison table
questions.modelAnswer: Documented search (1), >= 8 relevant recent papers (2), synthesis by theme (3), comparison table complete and correct (2), limitations identified (2).

questions.question: Open problems and your recommendation: what is still unsolved, and which direction would you pursue?
questions.guidance: Argue from the literature above. About 300–500 words.
questions.modelAnswer: Open problems grounded in reviewed work (2), recommendation justified (2), feasible for a student project (1).
